namo bodhisattvāya mañjuśriye kumārabhūtāya / kālatrayākhilajināṃśca tadīyadharmān saṅghān mahādaratayā praṇipatya cāpi / bodhiprabheṇa kathito viśadīkaromi śiṣyottamena khalu bodhipathapradipam
chinese: 禮敬三世一切佛 及彼正法與眾僧 應賢弟子菩提光 勸請善顯覺道燈

sanskrit: puruṣāstrividhā jñeyā uttamādhamamadhmāḥ / likhyate lakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ sphuṭaṃ pratyekabhedataḥ
chinese: 由下中及上 應知有三士 當書彼等相 各各之差別

sanskrit: upāyena tu kenāpi kevalaṃ saṃsṛteḥ sukham / svasyaivārthe ya īheta jñeyaḥ so puruṣo 'dhamaḥ
chinese: 若以何方便 唯於生死樂 但求自利益 知為下士夫

sanskrit: pāpakarmanivṛttātmā bhavasukhāt parāṅmukhaḥ / ātmanirvāṇamātrārthī yo naro madhyamastu saḥ
chinese: 背棄三有樂 遮止諸惡業 但求自寂滅 彼名為中士

sanskrit: svasantānagatairduḥkhairduḥkhasyānyasya sarvathā / sarvasya yaḥ kṣayaṃ kāṅkṣeduttamaḥ puruṣastu saḥ
chinese: 若以自身苦 比他一切苦 欲求永盡者 彼是上士夫

sanskrit: kāṅkṣanto hi varāṃ bodhiṃ sattvānāmuttamāstathā / darśitān gurubhistebhyaḥ sadupāyāṃ pracakṣmahe
chinese: 為諸勝有情 求大菩提者 當說諸師長 所示正方便

sanskrit: sambuddhacitramūrtyādistūpasaddharmasammukhaḥ / puṣpaidhupaiḥ padārthaiśca yathāprāptaiḥ supūjayet
chinese: 對佛畫像等 及諸靈塔前 以花香等物 盡所有供養

sanskrit: samantabhadracaryoktā pūjā saptavidhāpi ca / bodhisārasya paryantam avaivartikacittataḥ
chinese: 亦以普賢行 所說七支供 以至菩提藏 不退轉之心

sanskrit: suśraddhayā triratneyaḥ bhumau saṃsthāpya jānunī / bhūtvā kṛtāñjaliścāpi triścādau śaraṇaṃ vrajet
chinese: 信仰三寶尊 雙膝著於地 恭敬合掌已 先三遍皈依

sanskrit: tataḥ samastasattveṣu maitrīcitta puraskṛtaḥ / durgatitrayājanmādisaṅkrāntimaraṇādibhiḥ
chinese: 次一切有情 以慈心為先 觀惡趣生等 及死歿等苦

sanskrit: dṛṣṭvāśeṣaṃ jagaddukhaṃ duḥkhena dukhitāyāśca / duḥkhahetostathā duḥkhāt jagatāṃ muktikāṅkṣayā
chinese: 無餘諸眾生 為苦所苦惱 從苦及苦因 欲度脫眾生

sanskrit: bodhicittaṃ samutpādyamanāpāyipratijñayā / evaṃ praṇidhicittānām utpādetu guṇāśca ye
chinese: 力誓永不退 常發菩提心 如是發願心 所生諸功德 如華嚴經中 彌勒所宣說

sanskrit: te gaṇḍavyūhasūtreṣu maitreyeṇa prabhāṣitāḥ / sūtrasya tasya paṭhanācchravaṇād gurorvā sambodhicittaguṇakāni nirantakāni
chinese: 或讀彼經或師聞 了知正等菩提心 無邊功德為因緣 如是數數發其心

sanskrit: vijñāya tasya khalu saṃsthitārarṇāna / cittaṃ tathā samudayeta muhurmuhaśca / vīradattaparīpṛcchāsūtre puṇyaṃ pradarśitam
chinese: 勇施請問經 亦廣說此福 彼略攝三頌 今此當摘錄

sanskrit: yattacślokatrayeṇaiva samāsenātralikhyate / bodhicittāddhi yatpuṇyaṃ tacca rupi bhavedyadi
chinese: 菩提心福德 假使有色者 充滿虛空界 其福猶有餘

sanskrit: ākāśadhātuṃ sampūrya bhuyaścottari tadbhavet / gaṅgāvālikasaṅkhyāni buddhakṣetrāṇi yo naraḥ
chinese: 若人以珍寶 遍滿恆沙數 一切佛世界 供獻於諸佛

sanskrit: dadyātsadratna pūrṇāni lokanāthebhya eva hi / yaścaikaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā cittaṃ bodhāya nāmayet
chinese: 若有人合掌 心敬大菩提 此供最殊勝 其福無邊際

sanskrit: iyaṃ viśeṣyate pūjā yasyānto 'pi na vidyate / utpādyabodhipraṇidhānacittaṃ naikaprayatnaiḥ parivardhitavyam
chinese: 既發菩提願心已 應多勵力遍增長 此為餘生常憶念 如說學處當遍護

sanskrit: janmāntare 'pi smaraṇārthamasya śikṣā yathoktā paripālanīyā / prasthānacitte svayamātiriktaṃ samyagbhavenna praṇidhānavṛddhiḥ
chinese: 除行心體諸律儀 非能增長正願心 由欲增長菩提願 故當勵力受此律

sanskrit: sambodhisaṃvāra vivṛddhikāmaḥ tasmād dhruvaṃ cainamavāpnuyāta / saptadhāprātimokṣaiśca sadānyasaṃvarānvitaḥ
chinese: 若常具餘七 別解脫律儀 乃有菩薩律 善根余非有

sanskrit: bhāgyaṃ bodhisattvānāṃ saṃvarasya na cānyathā / saptadhā prātimokṣeṣu bhāṣiteṣu tathāgataiḥ
chinese: 七眾別解脫 如來所宣說 梵行為最勝 是比丘律儀

sanskrit: brahmacaryaśriyaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ bhikṣusaṃvara iṣyate / śīlādhyāyoktavidhinā bodhisattvasya bhumiṣu
chinese: 當以菩薩地 戒品所說軌 從具德相師 受持彼律儀

sanskrit: saṃvaraḥ sadgurorgrāhyaḥ samyaglakṣaṇayuktataḥ / yaḥ saṃvaravidhau dakṣaḥ svayaṃ ca saṃvare sthitaḥ
chinese: 善巧律儀軌 自安住律儀 堪傳律具悲 當知是良師

sanskrit: kṛpāluḥ saṃvare śaktaḥ jñātavyaḥ sadgurustu saḥ / tatra yatnena na prāpto guruścaitādṛśo yadi
chinese: 若努力尋求 不得如是師 當宣說其餘 受律儀軌則

sanskrit: saṃvaragrahaṇasyānyo vidhiḥ tasmāt samuyacte / ambararājabhutena pūrvaṃ mañjuśriyā yathā
chinese: 如昔妙吉祥 為虛空王時 所發菩提心 如文殊莊嚴

sanskrit: bodhicittaṃ samutpādi suspaṣṭaṃ cātra likhyate / mañjuśribuddhakṣetrālaṅkārasūtroktivat tathā
chinese: 佛土經所說 如是此當書 於諸依怙前 發大菩提心

sanskrit: utpādayāmi sambodhau cittaṃ nāthasya sammukham / nimantraye jagatsarvaṃ dāridyānmocitāsmi tat
chinese: 請一切眾生 度彼出生死 損害心忿心 慳吝與嫉妒

sanskrit: vyāpādakhilacittaṃ vā īrṣyāmātsaryameva va / adhyāgre na kariṣyāmi bodhiṃ prāpsyāmi yāvatā
chinese: 從今至證道 此等終不起 當修行梵行 當斷罪及欲

sanskrit: brahmacaryaṃ cariṣyāmi kāmāṃstyakṣyāmi pāpakān / buddhānāmānuśikṣiṣye śīlasaṃvara saṃyame
chinese: 愛樂戒律儀 當隨諸佛學 不樂為自己 速得大菩提

sanskrit: nāhaṃ tvaritarupeṇa bodhiṃ prāptumihotsahe / parāntakoṭiṃ sthāsyāmi sattvasyaikasya kāraṇāt
chinese: 為一有情因 住到最後際 當嚴淨無量 不思議佛土

sanskrit: kṣetraṃ viśodhiṣyāmi aprameyamacintim / nāmadheyaṃ kariṣyāmi daśadikṣu ca viśrutam
chinese: 受持於名號 及住十方界 我之身語業 一切使清淨 意業亦清淨 不作不善業

sanskrit: kāyavākkarmaṇī cāhaṃ śodhayiṣyāmi sarvaśaḥ / śodhayiṣye manaskarma kartāsmi nāśabham
chinese: 自身語意清淨因 謂住行心體律儀 由善學習三戒學 於三戒學起敬重

sanskrit: svakāyavākacittaviśuddhihetu, prasthānacittātmayamasthitena / triśīlaśikṣāpariśiyeta cet, triśīlaśikṣāsu mahādarasyāt
chinese: 如是勤清淨 菩薩諸律儀 便當能圓滿 大菩提資糧

sanskrit: śuddhasambodhisattvānāṃ tasmāt saṃvarasaṃvṛtau / yatnāt sambodhisambhāraḥ paripūrṇo bhaviṣyati
chinese: 福智為自性 資糧圓滿因 一切佛共許 為引發神通

sanskrit: puṇyajñānasvabhāvasya sambhārasya tu pūrtaye / sarvabuddhamatoheturabhijñotpāda eva hi
chinese: 如鳥未生翼 不能騰虛空 若離神通力 不能利有情

sanskrit: pakṣavṛddhiṃ vinā pakṣī khe noḍaḍetuṃ yathā kṣamaḥ / tathābhijñābalairhīnaḥ sattvārthakaraṇe 'kṣamaḥ
chinese: 具通者日夜 所修諸福德 諸離神通者 百生不能集

sanskrit: abhijñasya divārātrau yāni puṇyāni santi vai / abhijñāyāśca rāhitye naiva janmaśateṣu ca
chinese: 若欲速圓滿 大菩提資糧 要勤修神通 方成非懈怠

sanskrit: śīghraṃ sambodhisambhāraṃ sampūrayitumicchati / nirālasyena yatnenābhijñāṃ saṃsādhayettu saṃ
chinese: 若未成就止 不能起神通 為修成止故 應數數策勵

sanskrit: śamathasiddhayabhāve 'bhijñānaṃ na jāyate / ataḥ śamathasiddhayarthaṃ yatitavyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
chinese: 止支若失壞 即使勤修習 縱然經千載 亦不能得定

sanskrit: śamathaṅgaprahīṇatve tadyatnairbhāvite 'pi ca / saṃvatsarasahasraiśca samādhirnaiva setsyati
chinese: 故當善安住 定資糧品中 所說諸支分 於隨一所緣

sanskrit: ataḥ samādhisambhārādhyāyoktāṅgasamāśritaḥ / kasmiṃścit alambane 'pi puṇye saṃsthāpayenmanaḥ
chinese: 意安住於善 瑜珈若成止 神通亦當成 離慧度瑜珈

sanskrit: yoginaḥ śamathe siddhe 'bhijñānaṃ cāpi setsyati / prajñāpāramitāyogaṃ vinā nāvaraṇakṣayaḥ
chinese: 不能盡諸障 為無餘斷除 煩惱所知障 故應具方便

sanskrit: kleśajñeyāvṛtestasmāt prahāṇārthamaśeṣataḥ / prajñāpāramitāṃ yogī sopāyaṃ bhāvayet sadā
chinese: 修慧度瑜珈 般若離方便 方便離般若 俱說為系縛

sanskrit: upāyarahitā prajñāpyupāyaḥ prajñayā vinā / yato bandha iti proktau praheyaṃ nobhayaṃ tataḥ
chinese: 故二不應離 何慧何方便 為除諸疑故 當明諸方便

sanskrit: kā prajñā ka upāyaśca śaṅkāmiti nirāsitum / upāyasya ca prajñāyāḥ bhedaḥ samyak prakāśyate
chinese: 與般若差別 除般若度外 施般羅蜜等 一切善資糧

sanskrit: prajñāpāramitāṃ tyaktvā dānapāramitādayaḥ / sarve hi kuśalāḥ dharmāḥ upāyāḥ jinabhāṣitāḥ
chinese: 佛說為方便 苦修方便力 自善修般若 彼速證菩提

sanskrit: upāyābhyāsavaśyātmā yo hi prajñāṃ vibhāvayet / śīghraṃ sa labhate bodhiṃ na nairātmyaikabhāvanāt
chinese: 非單修無我 遍達蘊處界 皆悉無有生 了知自性空

sanskrit: skandhāyatanadhātūnāmanutpādāvabodhinām / svabhāvaśūnyatājñānaṃ prajñeti parikīrtitā
chinese: 說名為般若 有則生非理 無亦如空花 俱則犯俱過

sanskrit: sadutpattirayuktāsti asaccāpi khapuṣpavat / dvayordoṣaprasaṅgatvāt udbhāvo na dvayorapi
chinese: 故俱亦不生 諸法不自生 亦非他及共 亦非無因生

sanskrit: anutpannaḥ svato bhāvo parato nobhayorapi / ahetuteśca no tasmāt niḥsvabhāvaḥ svarupataḥ
chinese: 故無體自性 又一切諸法 用一異觀察 自性不可得

sanskrit: athavā sarvadharmāṇāṃ caikānekavicāraṇe / svarupāprāpyamāṇatvāt niḥsvabhāvatvaniścayaḥ
chinese: 定知無自性 七十空性理 及本中論等 亦成立諸法

sanskrit: śunyatāsaptau yuktau mūlamadhyamakādiṣu / siddho bhāvasvabhāvastu śunyatāyāṃ bhāṣitaḥ
chinese: 自性之空性 由恐文太繁 故此不廣說 僅就已成宗

sanskrit: granthasya gauravo yasmāt atra tasmānna vistaraḥ / siddhasiddhāntamātraikaṃ bhāvanārthaṃ prabhāṣitam
chinese: 為修故而說 故無餘諸法 自性不可得 所有修無我

sanskrit: tasmādaśeṣadharmāṇāṃ svabhāvanāmalābhataḥ / nairātmyabhāvanā yā hi sā prajñāyāstu bhāvanā
chinese: 即是修般若 以慧觀諸法 都不見自性 亦了彼慧性

sanskrit: prajñayā sarvadharmaṇāṃ yatsvabhāvo na dṛṣṭavat / yuktayā parīkṣya tāṃ prajñāṃ so 'vikalpena bhāvayet
chinese: 無分別修彼 三有分別生 分別為體性 故斷諸分別

sanskrit: bhavo vikalpobhūto 'yaṃ tadvikalpātmakastataḥ / sarvakalpaparityāgaḥ nivārṇaḥ paramo 'sti hi
chinese: 是最勝涅槃 如世尊曾說 分別大無明 能墮生死海

sanskrit: evamapyuktaṃ bhagavatā - - mahāvidyā vikalpo hi saṃsārārṇavapātakaḥ / nirvikalpasamādhisthe 'vikalpo bhāsate khavat
chinese: 住無分別定 無分別如空 如入無分別 陀羅尼亦云

sanskrit: avikalpapraveśadhāraṇyāmapi uktam - - cintitenirvikalpe 'smin saddharme jinaputrakaiḥ / vikalpaṃ durgamaṃ tīrtvāvikalpo prāpsyate kramāt
chinese: 佛子於此法 若思無分別 越分別險阻 漸得無分別

sanskrit: niścayīyāgamayuktibhyāṃ svabhāva rahitān tathā / sarvān dharmānutpannānavikalpaṃ bhāvayet
chinese: 由聖教正理 定解一切法 無生無自性 當修無分別

sanskrit: bhāvayannidamevetthaṃ prāpyoṣṇatvādikaṃ kramāt / labhate pramuditvādiṃ buddhabodhirna lambitā
chinese: 如是修真性 漸得暖等已 當得極喜等 佛菩提非遙

sanskrit: sādhitairmantraśaktayā hi śāntivistarakarmabhiḥ / bhadrakumbhādisiddhāṣṭamahāsiddhibalena ca
chinese: 由咒力成就 靜增等事業 及修寶瓶等 八大悉地力

sanskrit: abhīṣṭā bodhisambhāraparipūrtiḥ sukhena cet / kriyācaryādi tantrokam guhyācaraṇabhiṣyate
chinese: 欲安樂圓滿 大菩提資糧 須修事行等 續部諸密咒

sanskrit: tadācāryabhiṣekārthaṃ mahāratnādidānataḥ / sadguruṃ prīṇayed bhaktayā sarvāñjñādipālanaiḥ
chinese: 為求師長灌頂故 當以承事寶等施 依教行等一切事 使良師長心歡喜

sanskrit: prasanne ca gurau bhūte pūrṇācāryābhiṣekataḥ / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā siddhibhāgī bhaviṣyati
chinese: 由於師長心喜故 圓滿傳授師灌頂 清淨諸罪為體性 是修悉地善根者

sanskrit: ādibuddhamahātantre prayatnena niṣedhataḥ / guhyaprajñābhiṣekastu na grahyā brahmacārariṇā
chinese: 初佛大續中 極力遮止故 密與慧灌頂 梵行者勿受

sanskrit: so 'bhiṣeko gṛhītaścet brahyacaryatapaḥ sthitaiḥ / niṣiddhācaraṇatvāt tattapaḥ samvarakṣayaḥ
chinese: 倘持彼灌頂 安住梵行者 違犯所遮故 失壞彼律儀

sanskrit: jāyante vratinastasya pārājikavipattayaḥ / saḥ pateddurgatau nūnaṃ siddhirnaiva kadācana
chinese: 其持禁行者 則犯他勝罪 定當墮惡趣 亦無所成就

sanskrit: sarvatantraśrutau bhāṣye homayajñādikarmāsu / labdhācāryābhiṣekaśca tattvavida naiva duṣyati
chinese: 若聽講諸續 護摩祠祀等 得師灌頂者 知真實無過

sanskrit: dīpaṅkaraśriyā bodhipathaḥ proktaḥ samāsataḥ / dṛaṣṭvā sūtrādidharmoktiṃ bodhiprabhanivedanāt
chinese: 燃燈智上座 見經法等說 由菩提光請 略說菩提道
